posts.title: Review: Parallels 27 still the best at running Windows on a Mac – so long as it’s an Apple Silicon Mac
posts.description: More than six years ago, when Apple unveiled homegrown processors designed for its Mac computers, the company began a long, controlled journey away from the Intel chips it had used since 2006. The advent of Apple Silicon not only changed the company, it has had far-reaching impacts on the entire personal computer industry that are still being felt today.
